newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN WOOL INDICATOR RISES 1 CENT TO 696C/KG.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN WOOL INDICATOR RISES 1 CENT TO 696C/KG.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose one cent to 696 cents a kg clean on Thursday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece of 19/25/26 microns was up to 0.5 percent dearer, with 20/21/22m slightly dearer and 23/24m unchanged, while merino skirtings were fully firm.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were 0.5 percent dearer, 29/30m unchanged, and 31m 0.5 percent cheaper.
In cardings, lambs and crutchings were unchanged, with locks generally unchanged.
WI said Western Europe and Japanese interests were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 29,817 bales offered, 18.1 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Adelaide and Fremantle with about 100,150 bales to be offered.
